text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner! Here begins 
the final stage!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'll decide it...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――Yaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You is in the lead! Loves Only 
You crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she's so strong...! Isn't that Loves 
Only You girl insane!? The way she won was 
crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really looking forward to the 
Oaks...! There have been cases in the past 
where someone won consecutively starting 
from the Wasurenagusa Sho, right?"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan did it...!! Tonight is 
definitely gonna be a party...!!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"888888!!" "Congrats Loves-chan!!" "Did 
you see Loves-chan run?!" 
"Congratulations!" "So moving!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――We did it, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that really was the best race 
ever...!
Yeah, that was truly the best race...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――We did it, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that really was the best race 
ever...!
Yeah, that was truly the best race...!

text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You overcame the phlegmon and 
pulled off a magnificent, flawless 
victory.

With a performance like this, she has more 
than a fighting chance at the Oaks. It was 
a truly convincing display...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♪ I'd really love to celebrate 
together more, but we don't have that 
luxury, do we?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry and go watch! To see the ones 
we'll be competing against next...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Out of the fourth corner and into the 
homestretch! Gran Alegria takes the lead!! 
Gran Alegria in front, can she hold on!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: MI! LE! RRRRRRRRRRRRR!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria breaks away!!! Gran 
Alegriaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria puts on a display of 
unconventional speed!! A new record for 
the Oka Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Mmm!! Feels so gooood~~!! Happy 120 mph-!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheers!! Give me more and more 
of theeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—N-No way, seriously!? Ai-chan's record 
from last year has already been broken...! 
How is this even possible...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Winning like this in her first race of the 
year proves her potential is on another 
level...! We might just see back-to-back 
Triple Tiara winners!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... Truly... None of the existing 
race data is applying here—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I must hone it further. My... 'Genesis 
Method'...!

And so, just like last year, this year's 
Oka Sho heralded the arrival of a 
turbulent new era—
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
――So you won't be running in the Japanese 
Oaks, but instead heading for the NHK Mile 
Cup for your next race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I plan on aiming for the 'Alternative 
Double Crown'!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
While many fans were hoping for the Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks), what was the reason 
behind this course change? Was it 
distance, after all?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Um, there are all sorts of reasons, but 
the most important one is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to prove a kind of 
'strongest' that only I can achieve!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone! That the Triple Crown 
isn't the only path to being the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's a casual chat stream~! How's 
everyone doing lately? It's a new season, 
so I bet you're all pretty busy♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Time flies~" "Work is crazy right now" 
"Gran-chan is skipping the Yushun Himba" 
"Sleepy season" "The Yushun Himba is 
coming right up"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh♪ —Ah, I saw Gran-chan too~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was a little surprised, but... it's so 
like Gran-chan to stay true to herself. 
...I think that's really cool.

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"The Oka Sho was insane~!" "If she had 
gone to the Oaks, she'd be a menace." 
"Breaking the record is nuts."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'm sure Gran-chan will be the one 
forging the path at the forefront of our 
generation. But—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show off the best run I 
trained for at my own pace in the Oaks, 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whether Gran-chan is at the Oaks or not 
doesn't matter. I will prove it to the 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan isn't the only Tiara Umamusume 
this year. I'm here too!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"So cool!!" "Sasuga Loves~~↑↑" "So hyped 
★" "Watch out, racing world!" "Keep it 
up!" "I'm coming to see the Oaks!"

Loves Only You remains positive even 
during her streams. Even after witnessing 
Gran Alegria's sensational run in the Oka 
Sho firsthand, she wasn't intimidated in 
the slightest.
choice_data_list:
(I should take a page out of their book 
too.)

text_block_list.text:
On the path ahead of Loves Only You, many 
Umamusume would stand as formidable 
rivals.

Not to mention her peers, the chance to 
compete against the senior Umamusume who 
came before them might not be that far 
off—

However, no matter who the opponent is, I 
will do everything within my power to 
seize victory alongside Loves Only You.
choice_data_list: (That is my role as a bridge.)

text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks will soon be upon us. As if it 
can hardly wait for the birth of a new 
Queen of the Oaks—"
